name: Dawood Ibrahim
role: Indian-born organised-crime figure, alleged head of D-Company; UN-sanctioned and Indian-wanted fugitive
summary: Known as the alleged leader of the D-Company criminal network and wanted in India over the 1993 Bombay bombings. He has made no recorded political statements of his own, so no political position can be attributed to him.
